subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should an omitted `facing` in public node camera commands remain the documented front-camera default, or intentionally defer to each iOS device’s persisted Talk camera preference?
rationale: The intended feature requires changing behavior outside the local iOS fallback, while the existing agent-tool and documentation contract treat omission as front; this is a user-visible cross-surface compatibility decision rather than a mechanical repair choice.

options.title: Adopt the Talk preference contract
options.body: Leave `facing` absent through the normal agent path on iOS, document the platform behavior, preserve explicit-facing precedence, and prove the complete device flow.

options.title: Preserve fixed-front omission
options.body: Keep omitted camera commands front-facing and redesign the Talk control so it does not promise to affect ordinary agent camera captures.

options.title: Pause for a narrower API design
options.body: Defer the feature until owners define an explicit per-capture or per-session camera-selection contract shared by agent tools and native clients.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Talk preference contract
recommendation.body: Leave `facing` absent through the normal agent path on iOS, document the platform behavior, preserve explicit-facing precedence, and prove the complete device flow.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the current iOS Talk implementation and is the best available routing candidate from the supplied history, though current-main ownership could not be independently verified.
